proposals.rationale: Upgrading 'SHOULD' to 'MUST' closes the normative gap on PolicyGuard's rejection obligation when input data is missing. A fail-closed safety gate cannot be optional; permissive language permits compliant implementations that silently skip rejection, violating the fail-closed principle.
proposals.mechanical_details: Single-token substitution on line 4 of specs/CONTRACT.md. Replace 'SHOULD' with 'MUST'. No surrounding context changes required. Confirmed exact quote match from detector evidence.

replace_span.old_text: PolicyGuard SHOULD reject when data is missing.
replace_span.new_text: PolicyGuard MUST reject when data is missing.

proposals.callsite_evidence: crates/soldier_core/src/execution/engine_decision_tests.rs — PolicyGuard::resolve_trading_mode is called each tick; rejection path is exercised in existing fail_closed tests.

proposals.proposed_text: Remove the dangling 'AT-999 is referenced here' line. Register a new acceptance test AT-PROP-001 in the canonical AT registry covering PolicyGuard rejection on missing data, then replace line 3 with the registered anchor 'AT-PROP-001'.

new_ats.description: PolicyGuard MUST reject dispatch when a required input field is absent. Verify by invoking PolicyGuard with a nil/absent required input and asserting: dispatch_count == 0, reject_reason == MISSING_INPUT, and TradingMode is not Active.

proposals.rationale: The clause specifies rejection on missing data but omits the required safe-mode outcome. Without an explicit TradingMode transition (ReduceOnly or Kill), divergent implementations may reject the intent while leaving the system in Active mode, enabling further open-direction exposure. The fail-closed behaviour must be fully specified to be enforceable.
proposals.proposed_text: Append to the clause on line 4: 'When any required input is absent, PolicyGuard MUST set TradingMode to ReduceOnly and hold that mode until the missing input is restored and passes staleness validation. PolicyGuard MUST NOT revert to Active without a successful input-complete evaluation tick.'

new_ats.description: When a required PolicyGuard input is missing: (1) TradingMode MUST be ReduceOnly for the entire missing-input window, (2) no open-direction dispatch may occur during the ReduceOnly window (dispatch_count == 0 for open intents), (3) TradingMode MUST revert to Active only after a full valid-input tick is received and processed.
